Ruling: batch #162 item 3 · 不写 (a change to `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs` or any other tooling the presence instrument says owes no changeset gets none; the intent is recorded in the PR body; the instrument's own header states this, next to its false-positive sources; `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` is measured — if it contributes to the census it is removed in the next tooling PR) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T12:18Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **不写**; the maintainer agreed. Facts (this card; triage 5725894898): the census reads `.changeset/`, so a changeset written for a change to the census becomes its own input; PR #9765 wrote one (now in the corpus), PR #9793 declined with a declared reason; the repository's authoritative instrument `check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0 with 「0 of them published source of a package the release covers」 — the obligation half was never owed; only the 「record intent」 convention remained undecided and had been answered twice in opposite directions.

## Ruling — 不写

- Rule: a PR whose diff the presence instrument clears owes no changeset; intent goes in the PR body / commit message, ⛔ not into an empty-frontmatter changeset. The rule is written into the census script's header beside the 「three false-positive sources」 section so the next dev reads it in the code.
- Measurement, ⛔ not inference: count how many matched assertions `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` contributes today, with the ref; if non-zero, delete the file in the next tooling PR (noise, not a release note); if zero, leave it and record that.
- ⛔ 写: a convention that feeds a `.changeset/`-reading instrument a row about itself, and would need a self-exclusion (one more precision source) to stay honest.

Four-facet reading: ① the instrument's answer is the rule, no second convention; ② zero; ③ one fewer fork for the next dev; ④ nothing added.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:spec`, `priority:p3` stay. Serial with objectui#9767 / #9754 slice 2 / #9794 (same file, same pin) per the card's own fence.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#10077, reviewed against GitHub

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, `session_01QVJUngS9FKfuyQ9NFR2Nbn`, R+304, 2026-09-20T11:0xZ. Checklist conclusion + spot-check readings below; ⛔ the report's narration is not restated.

### Spot-checks taken by this seat on the PR itself

| item | reading |
| --- | --- |
| form | `draft: true` · base `main` · body first line **`Fixes #9795`** · head `abe39a91e3` · 1 commit |
| scope vs declared surface | **1 file**, `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs`, **+33 / -0** — exactly the granted surface, ⛔ nothing else touched |
| ⭐ comment-only, re-derived from the patch | of the 33 added lines, **NON-COMMENT added lines = 0**; removed lines = 0 ⇒ the claim holds against the diff, ⛔ not against the report |
| clause ② (`no`) | borne out: a zero-non-comment diff cannot move an accept set or a public surface. Neither `--tier` limb fires — no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no `yes` declaration ⇒ ⛔ no contract review owed, and `needs:contract-review` was correctly never hung on this card |
| governed path surface | `scripts/` is outside the governed definition (`docs/adr/**` · `.claude/**` · `skills/**` · `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` · `AGENTS.md` · `CLAUDE.md`) ⇒ ordinary queue route, ⛔ not the four-part endgame. 33 changed lines ⇒ the >5000-line rule does not fire either |
| `mcp_calls` | **0** ⇒ no denied tool was used; 2 REST writes, both accounted for |

### ⭐ The load-bearing judgement: obligation 3's conditional

The ruling removed `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` **only if measured to contribute**. The dev measured it and the condition is **FALSE** (0 matched assertions / 0 quoted / 0 superseded / 0 candidate contradictions), so the file was correctly **left byte-identical**.

⭐ What makes that zero a reading rather than a dead-instrument zero is the **ablation**: the census was re-run over a byte-identical corpus copy held **outside the repository** with one declaration sentence appended to that same entry, and the probe then attributed **1** matched assertion and **1** candidate contradiction to that exact entry name, with corpus totals moving 236→237 / 191→192 / 42→43. ⇒ the zero is a property of that file's TEXT, ⛔ not of the instrument's ability to attribute a reading to that filename. The tracked file was never mutated (injected token reads 0 in it, `git status` clean). ⭐ That is the right shape for a conditional that decides a deletion.

### ⚠️ CI — an honest `in_progress`, ⛔ NOT a pass

Read on head `abe39a91e3`: **33 check runs — 24 success, 3 skipped, 0 not-green, 6 still running** (`Lint`, `Type Check`, `Test` shards 1–4/4). The six outstanding are the load-bearing ones.

⇒ **ACCEPT is the review verdict; the landing is HELD.** The enqueue bar is 「every check green or an expected skip」, and six checks have not reported ⇒ ⛔ this PR is not flipped ready and ⛔ not enqueued in this act. It is flipped and enqueued at the next patrol once those six converge, and a red among them makes this a patch round instead.

### Deviations — accepted, both declared by the dev rather than found by me

1. Gate list **hand-derived** (39 workflow files enumerated from `origin/main` with an enumeration control) because `dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses for objectui. Correct, and the declaration is what makes it auditable.
2. A 维护者速读 section in the PR body although the diff touches **no** governed path. Harmless and offered, ⛔ not owed; the governed guard read `NOT GOVERNED` (1 path vs 5 governed surfaces).
3. `check:changeset-claims` exited 0 while **measuring nothing of its class** (this diff adds no changeset) — recorded as such, ⛔ not banked as coverage. ⭐ Exactly the right way to report a green that proves nothing.

### ⛔ Noted, not filed — and I agree it should not be

Nothing re-derives the header statement: no gate or pin asserts the section exists or that its wording is the ruled one, and `check-changeset-presence.mjs` enforces only in the direction of DEMANDING a changeset, never of forbidding one. ⚠️ That is the **ruled design**, ⛔ not a defect — the ruling's own words put the rule in 「the instrument's own header」, i.e. the maintainer chose documentation over a gate. Recorded so a later reader does not mistake it for an enforcement gap.

Also noted: five further corpus entries written for changes to this same instrument all contribute 0 today ⇒ the self-reference the card feared is real in principle and unrealised in practice. The ruling's conditional named one file, so ⛔ nothing else is removed. Successor for both: the CENSUS chain this card fences (#9767 · #9754 slice 2 · #9794).

## ✅ LANDED — verified by CONTENT on `origin/main`, ⛔ not from the `merged` field

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, `session_01QVJUngS9FKfuyQ9NFR2Nbn`, R+304, 2026-09-20T14:3xZ. Merged in one merge-queue batch at **14:12:36Z**; `origin/main` read at **`6980904793`**.

**Squash commit:** `3631937f docs(census): state the no-changeset-for-tooling ruling in the census header (objectui#9795) (#10077)`

The header now carries a section `## A change to THIS instrument carries no changeset (objectui#9795)`, placed **beside the false-positive list** as the ruling directed, whose RULE paragraph reads: a change to this script, or to any other tooling whose diff `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` clears, **gets NO changeset entry**, not even an empty-frontmatter one, and the intent is recorded in the PR body. It also states explicitly that the rule is **conditional on the presence instrument** and is ⛔ not a blanket exemption for `scripts/`.

Obligation 3 did **not** fire: `.changeset/9754-polarity-clause-scope.md` was measured to contribute **0** to the census, so per the ruling it was correctly left byte-identical.

### ⛔ An instrument error of my own, recorded

My first verification probe searched for the phrase 「owes no changeset」 and read **0**. That phrase is one **I invented**; the file says 「gets NO changeset entry」. ⇒ the zero was an artefact of a guessed needle, ⛔ not a missing statement, and it was re-probed against the actual text before this record was written. ⭐ Recorded because a zero from a needle nobody checked is exactly the failure this lane keeps a register of.

### Half-state cleared in the same act

Keyword closing (`Fixes`) closes the card but leaves `pm:dispatched` and the assignee behind — a documented trap on this board. Both were cleared and read back: labels now `domain:spec` + `priority:*` only, assignees **none**. ⛔ `domain:*` and the priority label stay — ownership is not state.
